en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (ra) narrated to us. He said: Abu Ahmad `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya b. Ahmad b. `Isa al-Juludi al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sahl narrated to us. He said: Al-Khidr b. Abi Fatima al-Balkhi narrated to us. He said: Wahib b. Nafi` narrated to us. He said: Kadih narrated to me from Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali (as).
Regarding His saying, “Peace be with the Family of Yasin” [37:130], he said: Yasin is Muhammad (s), and we are the Family of Yasin.
